description: Marcas de Nivelamento da ilha de São Miguel - Região Autónoma dos Açores (RAA) is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . Leveling marks to support the topographical survey, of the island of São Miguel. Coverage: Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . The portal shows the English title as "Leveling marks of the island of São Miguel - Autonomous Region of the Azores (RAA)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . Its keywords include acores, marcas-de-nivelamento, nivelamento, raa, local, localizacao. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
